description: Provision real GPU compute on Kilawatt Cloud. Charges the caller's Kilawatt wallet and starts an actual machine. Set dry_run to true to price the run and check balance, spend caps, rate limits and concurrency without provisioning or charging anything.

dry_run.description: Price and pre-authorize only. Returns the cost estimate, the routing order and whether the account is authorized, without provisioning or charging.

duration_seconds.description: How long the node is needed, in seconds. Billed up front.

gpu_type.description: GPU model identifier, e.g. nvidia-h100, nvidia-h200, nvidia-b200.

routing_policy.description: How the smart order router picks a node.

name: deploy_gpu_node
